phases: LIFT the finger off the panel (calibration with nothing on it)
finger DOWN on position A (the corner where it sits in the stent runs), keep STILL
move to position B (~2 cm further along the top edge) and keep STILL
move to position C (~2 cm further again) and keep STILL
move back to position A and keep STILL
SLIDE slowly back and forth along the top edge between A and C, always touching
rest the finger on position A and keep STILL (long hold: drift / recalibration check)
